# Salt Analysis

Class 12 CBSE / ISC qualitative salt analysis writeups.
https://saltanalysis.com

Copper sulphate is blue. Ammonium chloride smells of ammonia. Write BaCl2, not Ba(Cl)2.

## Common salts

- Ammonium Chloride (NH4Cl): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/nh_4|cl/analysis
- Lead Acetate (Pb(CH3COO)2): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/pb|ch_3coo/analysis
- Ammonium Carbonate ((NH4)2CO3): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/nh_4|co_3/analysis
- Ammonium Sulphate ((NH4)2SO4): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/nh_4|so_4/analysis
- Aluminium Sulphate (Al2(SO4)3): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/al|so_4/analysis
- Lead Nitrate (Pb(NO3)2): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/pb|no_3/analysis
- Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/zn|so_4/analysis
- Barium Chloride (BaCl2): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/ba|cl/analysis
- Aluminium Nitrate (Al(NO3)3): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/al|no_3/analysis
- Copper Sulphate (CuSO4): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/cu|so_4/analysis
- Magnesium Sulphate (MgSO4): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/mg|so_4/analysis
- Lead Chloride (PbCl2): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/pb|cl/analysis
- Strontium Chloride (SrCl2): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/sr|cl/analysis
- Barium Nitrate (Ba(NO3)2): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/ba|no_3/analysis
- Calcium Carbonate (CaCO3): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/ca|co_3/analysis
- Zinc Chloride (ZnCl2): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/zn|cl/analysis
- Ammonium Oxalate ((NH4)2C2O4): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/nh_4|c_2o_4/analysis
- Barium Bromide (BaBr2): https://saltanalysis.com/salt/ba|br/analysis
